Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up — HW partner just emailed: they need to reduce our Q2 rack allocation by 25% due to a supply chain re-prioritization. Lead times for the remaining units slip from 6 weeks -> 14 weeks.
Liam (Procurement): Ugh. Do we know which SKUs are affected? Any impact on Dedicated commitments?
Maya (Partnerships): Partner listed affected SKUs in their note: P1000x-80 and P1000x-40. They said reserved bundles (our committed Dedicated pools) are first in line but only if confirmed by EOD. Otherwise they’ll reallocate to strategic channel partners.
Jordan (Cloud Partnerships): That could hit our Dedicated rollout schedule for EMEA. Also — marketplace listings might show availability mismatch if we don't sync. Can we block reallocation?
SupplyBot: Automated update from partner-ops: "Allocation change request: PO# 782331 will face 25% reduction unless confirmation received by 2026-05-01T23:59Z. Affected SKUs: [P1000x-80, P1000x-40]. Estimated new ETA: 14 weeks. Contact: ops@hwpartner.example"
Liam (Procurement): I'm pulling our POs now. If we confirm, does the partner require additional deposit? Maya — did they mention cost delta?
Maya (Partnerships): They flagged potential expedited fees for prioritizing our units (20% surcharge). No firm invoice yet — they want written confirmation of which POs we want honored.
Aisha (Sales Eng): If we lose 25% of Dedicated capacity we'll need to delay two pilot customers' D-level SLAs. I'll flag the customers and draft messaging.
Jordan (Cloud Partnerships): For marketplace, we should toggle availability flag to "limited" and add ETA note. Also pause any joint announcement we have penciled for next month. 
Liam (Procurement): Proposed immediate steps: 1) Confirm which POs we want to keep by 18:00 PT. 2) Negotiate expedited fee waiver / commitment swap with partner. 3) Check alternative supply (secondary vendor) for quick fill.
Maya (Partnerships): I'll ask partner if they can trade units from a later shipment vs surcharge. Also asking if we can accept mixed SKUs (40->80) as temporary substitution.
SupplyBot: Partner response (automated): "Substitutions allowed within same family subject to validation. Please submit confirmation CSV with PO#, SKU, qty by 2026-05-01T23:59Z."
Liam (Procurement): I'll export a PO inventory report and propose a short list. Attaching sample CSV template: ```po_id,sku,qty,confirm_keep
782331,P1000x-80,10,yes
782332,P1000x-40,20,no
```
Aisha (Sales Eng): I'll prepare customer impact notes — which pilot gets shifted and suggested compensations.
Jordan (Cloud Partnerships): Also looping in the marketing comms owner — we should avoid surprise press. Maya, can you pause the embargo on the joint blog until we have a concrete allocation?
Maya (Partnerships): Yes pausing now. I'll reply to partner with a provisional keep-list and push for no surcharge.
Liam (Procurement): I'll share the PO list in #procurement and add action owners. If partner holds firm, we might need to accelerate secondary supplier onboarding.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks — will update the thread once partner confirms. :thumbsup:
Aisha (Sales Eng): tagging customers' CSMs now.
Jordan (Cloud Partnerships): Noted — will change marketplace availability copy to "temporarily limited" if we don't get confirmation within 24h.
Maya (Partnerships): Action items summarized: - Liam: PO export + confirmation CSV by 18:00 PT - Maya: negotiate substitution / surcharge waiver - Aisha: customer impact notes + messaging - Jordan: hold marketplace & marketing announcements - SupplyBot: continue to relay partner updates
Liam (Procurement): On it.
SupplyBot: Next automated partner update queued in 6 hours."
